title: Linearity of g ↦ ∫_S div g on compactly supported C¹ vector fields
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let S ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set. Write div g(x) for the trace of the Fréchet derivative Dg(x) (SimonGMT Chapter02.euclideanDivergence) and ∫_S for the Lebesgue integral over S. (i) If g, h : ℝ^N → ℝ^N are C¹ with compact support, then ∫_S div(g + h) dL^N = ∫_S div g dL^N + ∫_S div h dL^N. (ii) If c ∈ ℝ and g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N is C¹, then ∫_S div(c g) dL^N = c ∫_S div g dL^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn N)), (∀ g h : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → ∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (g + h) x = (∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x) + ∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence h x) ∧ ∀ (c : ℝ) (g : Rn N → Rn N), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → ∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (c • g) x = c * ∫ x in S, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x
